generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non- accessibility of KPPP portals due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification.
Rates shall be quoted online in KPPP portal.
The tender shall be valid for 180 days from the date of opening.
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement.
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.
The bidder shall obtain Workmen compensatory insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work.
The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other applicable taxes, levies, duties and Building Workers Welfare Cess at 1% etc.,
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax, building workers welfare cess, at the prevailing applicable rates.
The bidder shall upload/submit online duly signed copy of Form of Tender and Declaration by Bidder formats under Section 3 of bid document.
Bidders should have an independent PF code. The bidder shall remit PF of labourers to Contractors permanent PF code number only and not to the KPCL PF sub code.
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned.
If the Bidder makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection.
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the web site only.
Any revision in GST rates during execution of work will be paid to the contractor by KPCL or recovered from the bills of the contractor
Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer (Gates)S, KPC Ltd., Kargal, Sagara Tq 577421.

In proof of the above, a copy of work done certificate issued from the competent authority & the corresponding work order shall be furnished. (Note: The value of completed works shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited).

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Design, fabrication, supply, erection and commissioning of 2 nos of trash rack panels at MGHE forebay

itemList.description: Dismantling steel work in built up sections in angles, tees, flats and channels of existing damaged trash rack panels at MGHE Forebay gate No.2 & 3 and other associated parts including all gusset plates, bolts, nuts, cutting rivets, welding etc. using gas cutting. Post cutting, the corroded materials shall be thoroughly ground and the surface prepared/kept ready for subsequent welding. The work shall be comprehensive, including the provision of scafolding, cutting, all tool complete including scaffolding ,cutting gas, all tools and tackles, gas, labour etc,.

Cutting grooves, pockets, openings in concrete to specified size carefully without damaging the adjoining area including disposal of debris, cleaning the area, etc., complete with lead upto 50m and all lifts. (For Power House and Allied works).More than 100 mm upto 200 mm depth from surface

Drilling 25 mm / 32 mm dia. Holes vertical or inclined in concrete / masonry / rock by percussion drilling method using jack hammer as directed to specified depth including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning holes with all other ancillary operations complete.

Fixing anchor rods in pre drilled hole using Fosroc Lockfix high-performance, ie., two-part polyester resin or epoxy anchoring grouts designed for fixing bolts, rebar, and dowels into concrete, rock, masonry, or brickwork. It includes cost of all materials, labour, tools and tackles cleaning of Drill hole and ensure it is free of dust, debris, and water. etc., complete as per specification.

Providing and erecting temporary arrangements for safe lifting and lowering of trash rack panels using chain pulley blocks, including fabrication, supply, erection of necessary supporting arrangements such as temporary columns, beams, brackets, base plates and other structural members. The work shall include all required materials, cutting, welding, bolting, alignment, erection, labour, tools, tackles, lifting equipment and other incidental works necessary for safe and proper execution, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.Upon completion of the errection work, all temporary structures shall be dismantled and demobilized without causing any structural distress or damage to adjacent permanent structures, complete as per the directions of the Engineer-in-Charge

Design, fabrication, supply, erection and commissioning of trash racks consisting of a number of panels of suitable height with vertical trash bars welded to structural steel frame at wider interval for intake structure including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cutting, aligning, welding (using E7018 electrode) finishing, cleaning, applying one coat of zinc rich epoxy primer and four coats cold applied coal tar epoxy paint and all other ancillary operations complete as per specifications and approved drawings.

Providing and placing M 30 Polymer concrete/Micro concrete, in sill beam and groove, hard clean approved aggregates. Placing in position, centering,levelling, curing, finishing with steel shuttering and applying a coat of suitable bonding agent just before placing of MC after finishing the concrete surface shall be coated with cement polymer compound to fill the surface pores to get a smooth surface as directed with all lead and lifts etc.,

Rectification of damaged wicket gate assembly for head gate No.4. Which includes dismantling of old damaged assembly parts and replacement of defective parts, scaffolding arrangements, testing, lubrication, cost of labour, materials, machinery tools and tackles, jula/scaffolding required for the work etc.,
Shifting of released materials to designated store yard, it includes cost of loading, lifting, transportation etc., complete

Providing, erecting, maintaining temporary scaffolding and safety barriers downstream of the existing trash rack (approx width of 7 m) to prevent the ingress of fabrication debris, slag, and iron pieces into the downstream system, while ensuring full fall protection for working personnel. The rate is all-inclusive of all structural materials, safety nets, tools, tackles, lifting machinery, labor, transportation, and handling.
Upon completion of the errection work, all temporary structures shall be dismantled and demobilized without causing any structural distress or damage to adjacent permanent structures, complete as per the directions of the Engineer-in-Charge

Dewatering of the pit/well downstream of the trash rack, including inspection and removal of accumulated silt, debris and other foreign materials. The rate shall be completely all-inclusive and shall cover the cost of dewatering pumps, power sources, suction and delivery hoses, lifting and disposal arrangements for removed debris, scaffolding, tools and tackles, machinery, labour, transportation, and all other necessary materials, equipment and ancillary arrangements required for safe and satisfactory completion of the work as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.
